surfaceTypes.notes: Distinguished from pasture (grazed, animal-cropped, fenced) and from wild meadow (no human cut cycle) by the seasonal MOW/windrow cycle. Reuses the already-shipped hay_bales D6 object + its biome list as a genuine available no-mock anchor.

tierRecommendation: Sort by READINESS (no-mock claim availability) and formality, but NONE deferred — all 13 ship. TIER A (AVAILABLE-today, ride existing anchors, generate first as the class's proof): g_managedgreen_doorstep_courtyard, g_managedgreen_raised_bed_garden, g_managedgreen_cloister_physic_garden — these ride architectureClaimAt() perimeter ring + existing building roles (healing_order/herbalist/herbseller/monastery) + the door socket, needing NO new region declaration; they prove the managed-flora-override + paint-pass machinery on claims the sim ALREADY emits, exactly mirroring the D0-first 'cheapest proof' discipline. TIER B (district WEDGE available, sub-region declared — the working-land core of the class): g_managedgreen_tilled_field, g_managedgreen_orchard_rows, g_managedgreen_fenced_pasture, g_managedgreen_hay_meadow_managed, g_managedgreen_vineyard_rows — all sit inside the AVAILABLE agricultural district wedge + lean on available role/D6 hints (olive_press, the 4 stable specs, hay_bales biome list), needing only a per-plot region+axis declaration in layout.js; tilled_field is the marquee 'managed flora overrides natural flora' surface and should anchor this tier. TIER C (formal ornamental, needs a declared garden/lawn/cemetery PRECINCT but reuses the formal kerb Wang skeleton heavily): g_managedgreen_formal_parterre, g_managedgreen_manicured_lawn, g_managedgreen_hedge_lined_walk, g_managedgreen_topiary_court, g_managedgreen_cemetery_lawn — these are the showcase of the biome-agnostic kerb corpus wearing green skins (clipped hedge = the same 6 masks as a stone kerb) and depend on declaring entertainment-garden / civic-green / religious-churchyard precincts. Implementation reuse: every surface composes from a SMALL shared fill set (turf, worked-soil, gravel-path, bed-soil) + the one shared 6-piece kerb Wang skeleton (re-skinned as box-edging/coping/board) + procedural fringe + deterministic lattices (furrow/row/grave/bed/mow), so the authored asset count is tiny relative to 13 surfaces; the heavy lifting is the managedFlora flora-override channel (generalizing the roads 'paved' suppression delta) + per-tile deterministic pattern functions.
gaps: NO-MOCK GAP (the big one): layout.js emits district WEDGES (agricultural/entertainment/religious) and places BUILDINGS in them, but emits NO ground SUB-REGIONS — no tilled field plots, orchard/vineyard grids, declared gardens/parterres, cemeteries, paddocks, or hay meadows. 8 of 13 surfaces are NEEDS-DECLARING for exactly this reason. A new declareManagedRegions() pass must subdivide each district wedge's non-building open land into plots with a kind (field/orchard/vineyard/pasture/garden/cemetery/lawn) + a long-axis/origin/spacing, deterministically and respecting building footprints + spines. Until then these surfaces have a coarse wedge container but no precise polygon.

FLORA-OVERRIDE CHANNEL: the whole class hinges on a managedFlora override that SUPPRESSES natural F0-F8 flora and re-seeds a managed pattern. The roads-sim 'paved' flora-suppression delta is the proven precedent, but it is binary (paved vs not) and opaque; managed green needs it generalized to a typed channel (tilled/sown/mown/grazed/bedded/grassed) that still lets the underlying biome show through and that the F0-F8 decoration-claim path checks before placing wild flora. This generalization does not exist yet — it is the single most load-bearing engine change for this class.

SEASONAL/CROP-PHASE SOURCE: tilled_field, vineyard, orchard, hay_meadow, parterre and cemetery-flowers all want a crop/bloom PHASE that cycles with season. Season is 'available where cued' per the dressing manifest, but a per-plot crop ASSIGNMENT + planting calendar (what is sown here, when harvested) is not emitted by any sim system today — so the phase is deterministic-by-tile-and-date but the SEMANTIC crop identity is honestly-absent until an agriculture sim assigns crops to plots. Default to a biome-plausible crop until then; do not invent a per-plot crop economy.

WETNESS for paddy/waterlogging: the rice-paddy climate-swap + waterlogged-furrow + poached-pasture-mud puddle-wet affordances all want the wetness 0-1 scalar that the dressing audit already flags as honestly-absent (terrain-suitability exposes only BINARY water predicates; hydrology.js could supply a scalar but is unintegrated). Same gap as the D0 water surfaces — paddy/waterlog affordances are dormant until wetness is wired.

VINTNER/ORCHARDIST ROLE HINTS are partial: olive_press (→olive grove) and the 4 stable specs (→paddock) and healing_order/herbalist/herbseller (→herb garden) are genuine available no-mock role anchors, but there is NO dedicated vintner/vineyard, orchardist, or arable-farmer specialization, so vineyard_rows and tilled_field lean almost entirely on the agricultural district wedge rather than a building role. Adding those specializations later would strengthen the no-mock grounding (and is the honest way to do it — not hardcoding vineyards).

HEDGE/FENCE/TREE/HEADSTONE as PROPS vs GROUND: several surfaces (hedge-walk, orchard, vineyard, pasture, cemetery, topiary) define a ground BAND but rely on D6 perimeter/scatter PROPS for the vertical body (hedge volume, trees, trellis, fences, headstones). This couples the grounds G-stack to the D5/D6 prop scatter engine + its lattice-placement — a cross-stack dependency that must be co-designed so the prop lattice and the ground pattern share the same deterministic f(wx,wy + region axis) seed and don't disagree.

MAINTENANCE honestly-absent → kept-vs-overgrown: formal surfaces (parterre, topiary, cemetery, cloister, lawn) have a sharp 'kept' vs 'neglected/overgrown' axis driven by maintenance, which the dressing audit lists as honestly-absent. Per that rule these default to KEPT (no overgrowth, no encroaching wild flora) until a maintenance/upkeep sim source exists; an abandoned overgrown graveyard/garden is DECLARED-but-DORMANT, not faked.

TERRACING ON SLOPES: mountain/hill tilled_field, orchard, vineyard want CONTOUR-following terraced rows rather than a flat lattice — this needs the plot's row-axis to follow the local elevation contour (elevation data exists via elevation-overlay/terrain-suitability) rather than a straight declared axis. The contour-aligned lattice variant is a NEEDS-DECLARING geometry mode not yet specced.

KERB SKELETON GREEN SKINS unproven in PixelLab: the formal surfaces assume the shared 6-piece kerb Wang skeleton can wear a clipped-low-hedge / churchyard-coping / board-bed-edging skin as cleanly as a stone kerb. That biome/material-agnostic re-skin is asserted by the engine design but, like the composable building pieces, is UNPROVEN in the PixelLab pipeline and needs a pilot batch + assembly probe before the formal-tier burst (pilot-before-burst discipline).
